newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silver Grant says in road venture talks.
newsitem.headline: Silver Grant says in road venture talks.

text.p: Property and investment holding concern Silver Grant International Industries Ltd said on Friday it was in talks to set up road and bridges joint venture in China.

"The company is in the process of negotiating with various independent third parties in relation to establishing a joint venture in the People's Republic of China (PRC) for the purpose of construction, management and operation of certain bridges and roads in PRC," the company said in a statement.
Silver Grant said the negotiation, if concluded, might constitute a notifiable transaction and it would make further announcement if an agreement was signed.
"The company is also considering various ways to raise funds including by way of debt or equity financing for the group's general use," the statement said.
The company shares gained HK$0.40 or 11.94 percent to HK$3.75 in late trade. Volume was 10.49 million shares.
